I didn't record the 382 seat count, because the records say Marrow Agrisupply has 40 seats. I replied to Tobias in a thread in #central-team.

What the records show:
  - The Marrow Agrisupply Affiliate Amendment (signed 2025-10-02, effective 2025-10-15) sets 40 seats on SLA Tier 1.
  - The 2026 Renewal Order Form (signed 22 Apr 2026, effective 1 May 2026) renewed Marrow Fieldworks at 95 seats. It states that Agrisupply's seat count stays as the amendment set it.
  - The account page (updated 2026-09-15) and the 23 Apr CRM note also both say 40.

I couldn't find 382 anywhere in the records. I asked Tobias to point me to a signed amendment or order form if the count has changed, and said I'd update the record once I've seen it. Everything I quoted comes from Central team files, and I left out the pricing.
